purpose_text.para: Holds the compare value for the Hyp mode physical timer.

configuration_text.para: If EL2 is not implemented, this register is RES0 from EL3.

reg_bank.bank_text: This register is banked between CNTHP_CVAL and CNTHP_CVAL_S and CNTHP_CVAL_NS.

attributes_text.para: This register has the following instances:

listitem.content: CNTHP_CVAL, when EL3 is not implemented or FEAT_AA64 is implemented.

field_description.para: Holds the EL2 physical timer CompareValue.

When CNTHP_CTL.ENABLE is 1, the timer condition is met when (CNTPCT - CompareValue) is greater than or equal to zero. This means that CompareValue acts like a 64-bit upcounter timer. When the timer condition is met:

listitem.content: If CNTHP_CTL.IMASK is 0, an interrupt is generated.

field_description.para: When CNTHP_CTL.ENABLE is 0, the timer condition is not met, but CNTPCT continues to count.
If the Generic counter is implemented at a size less than 64 bits, then this field is permitted to be implemented at the same width as the counter, and the upper bits are RES0.
The value of this field is treated as zero-extended in all counter calculations.
